question: What was the overall success rate last week?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status='SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sr FROM transactions WHERE txn_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-09' AND DATE '2026-11-15'

question: Success rate by payment method in October
reference_sql: SELECT payment_method_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status='SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sr FROM transactions WHERE txn_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-31' GROUP BY 1

question: How many payment attempts were there in September?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM transactions WHERE txn_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'

question: What was GMV last month?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status='SUCCESS' THEN amount_inr ELSE 0 END) AS gmv FROM transactions WHERE txn_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-31'

question: Daily UPI success rate from Nov 9 to Nov 15
reference_sql: SELECT txn_date, SUM(CASE WHEN status='SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sr FROM transactions WHERE payment_method_id='UPI' AND txn_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-09' AND DATE '2026-11-15' GROUP BY 1

question: Failure rate by channel last week
reference_sql: SELECT channel, SUM(CASE WHEN status='FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fr FROM transactions WHERE txn_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-09' AND DATE '2026-11-15' GROUP BY 1

question: How many payment attempts were there in October?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM transactions WHERE region='South' AND txn_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-31'

question: Success rate by merchant category in September
reference_sql: SELECT m.category, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status='SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sr FROM transactions t JOIN merchants m USING (merchant_id) WHERE t.txn_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1

question: Average latency for netbanking in October
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(response_ms) AS lat FROM transactions WHERE payment_method_id='NB' AND txn_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-31'
